head.t: Boston Scientific wins £12.8k urology laser replacement at Swansea Bay
head.x: Swansea Bay University Health Board has directly awarded Boston Scientific a contract to replace the end-of-life urology laser at Morriston Hospital with a Lumenis MOSES Pulse 120H device, worth £12,822.15 excluding VAT.
